exposure: Surgical modalities for Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (ultrasound-guided dilation and curettage, hysteroscopic surgery, combined hysteroscopic and laparoscopic surgery)

Clinical and demographic factors (e.g., age, gestational age at CSP diagnosis, number of deliveries, previous miscarriages, previous cesarean sections, CSP type, use of methotrexate, post-treatment uterine adhesions)
outcome: Subsequent pregnancy outcomes (live births, ectopic pregnancy, miscarriage)
cohort: The study cohort comprised 460 women diagnosed with Cesarean Scar Pregnancy (CSP) in their first trimester, admitted to the Ninth People's Hospital of Suzhou between January 2015 and December 2023.
finding: A high success rate in achieving subsequent pregnancy and a low CSP recurrence rate were observed after surgical treatment for CSP, with miscarriages and post-treatment uterine adhesions identified as risk factors for failure to achieve pregnancy.
